items.headline: Commanders snap Seattle's 12-game winning streak, beat the Seahawks 33-31
items.description: — Marcus Mariota threw three touchdown passes, and Kain Medrano returned an interception 50 yards for a touchdown to help the Washington Commanders hand Seattle its first loss since November, 33-31 on Sunday.

items.headline: QB Sam Darnold back Sunday, but Seahawks down two safeties
items.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold will start Sunday, but the defending Super Bowl champions will be without both starting safeties as Julian Love and Ty Okada have been ruled out.
